predictions.text: I predict that the Egyptian troops will not engage the invading forces, following a prominent military leader's order to stay put.
I predict that the Democrats will win a majority of the seats in the Texas House of Representatives, but the Republicans will still hold a significant number of seats.
I predict that Saudi Arabia will launch airstrikes against two residential buildings in Taiz, Yemen, by the end of Saturday, 7 November 2026.

I predict that the results of the investigation into the 2026 Brčko helicopter crash will be released, detailing the cause of the accident and any recommendations for preventing future incidents, with the report mentioning that the Italian Air Force will implement at least two new safety measures.

I predict that the Center Party's leader, an important politician, leads the new government after the second vote, forming a coalition with the Social Democrats, Greens, Christian Democrats, and the Moderates, with the vote taking place on Saturday, 7 November 2026, in the Swedish parliament building.

I predict that Cohere will have secured up to C$1.6 billion (US$1.1 billion) of the C$7 billion funding round by the end of this week, with the investment coming from Canada's federal government and other unspecified sources.

I predict that another major cryptocurrency exchange based in the Seychelles will announce similar actions by the end of Saturday, 7 November 2026, ending services for customers in Russia and Belarus.
I predict that the Saudi-led coalition intercepts at least two more drones allegedly launched by the Houthis towards the Mecca region.
I predict that Russian attacks on civilians in Dnipro, Ukraine will result in at least 14 more people being killed and 14 more being injured by the end of Saturday, 7 November 2026.
I predict that Azerbaijan wins the FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival.
